themes.name: Navy submarine hardware manufacturing
themes.thesis_summary: Graham Corporation is the monopolistic supplier of critical vacuum and heat transfer equipment for Navy nuclear submarine propulsion systems. The FY2027 defence budget of $1.01 trillion prioritises submarine modernisation. Backlog reached $515.6M with 2.3x book-to-bill, providing multi-year revenue visibility.
themes.why_now: FY2027 defence budget $1.01T (+14.5%); submarine modernisation top-3 priority; backlog at record levels
primary_risks: Stock already tripled; above analyst consensus

themes.name: CAR-T autoimmune first-to-market
themes.thesis_summary: Kyverna holds the world's most advanced autoimmune CAR-T dataset (KYSA-8 in SPS: 81% clinically meaningful improvement, all endpoints p<0.0001). BLA filing imminent for the first non-oncology CAR-T approval. $7.3B in preclinical M&A validates the therapeutic paradigm while KYTX holds registrational data.
themes.why_now: AAN conference April 18-22 presents full primary analysis; BLA filing 1H 2026; $7.3B in autoimmune CAR-T M&A across 6 deals since March 2025
primary_risks: No precedent for non-oncology CAR-T approval

themes.name: Oral CETP inhibitor regulatory filing
themes.thesis_summary: NewAmsterdam's obicetrapib is the only CETP inhibitor in late-stage development globally. It delivers 33-42% LDL-C reduction with ~45% Lp(a) reduction in a single oral pill. Five catalysts in 18 months (ACC.26, EMA decision, RUBENS, NDA filing, PREVAIL CVOT) create compounding re-rating potential.
themes.why_now: EMA decision expected 2H 2026; PREVAIL CVOT readout late 2026/early 2027; oral LDL market estimated $12-18B by 2030
primary_risks: BROOKLYN Phase 3 LDL gap vs Phase 2

themes.name: CGT cold chain logistics monopoly
themes.thesis_summary: Cryoport serves ~70% of the global CGT pipeline and 20 commercial therapies. Each new FDA approval creates recurring logistics revenue. At $70M enterprise value on $192M guided revenue with $411M cash, the stock is priced for failure while approaching its first positive EBITDA quarter.
themes.why_now: EBITDA inflection H2 2026; 9 new therapy approvals and 13 BLA/MAA filings guided for 2026; convertible note overhang clears December 2026

themes.name: EM cross-border payment infrastructure
themes.thesis_summary: DLocal processes payments for 6 of the Magnificent Seven across 44 emerging markets. Revenue grew 47% to $1.09B with 35.6% ROE. Forward P/E of 14.9x vs 39.5x fintech peer average. PATH CONVERGENCE (contrarian value trough + momentum confirmation) detected.
themes.why_now: Q1 2026 earnings May 14; $300M buyback programme; first-ever dividend; turnaround CEO executing

themes.name: 800G optical interconnect ramp
themes.thesis_summary: MaxLinear designs 800G PAM4 DSP chips for data center optical interconnects. Revenue inflecting +48% y/y from cyclical trough as hyperscaler capex reaches $690B. The AI data center buildout creates structural demand for higher-bandwidth optical links.
themes.why_now: Revenue inflection from trough; 800G deployment cycle beginning; $690B hyperscaler capex committed
